Q: Thank you for agreeing to give a recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my full name on a recording, but you can note that I'm the driver of the vehicle that was struck.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the collision happened?
A: It was on a main road in Pasadena, Texas, near a shopping center. I was stopped in traffic at a red light when it
happened.
Q: What happened right before the impact?
A: I had come to a complete stop behind a line of cars. I checked my mirror, saw nothing unusual, and then felt a hard
jolt from behind.
Q: Did the other driver say anything at the scene?
A: They apologized and said they'd looked down at their phone for a second. They didn't seem hurt, but they were
upset about the damage.
Q: Were you injured?
A: Yes. My neck was sore almost right away, and by the next morning I had stiffness and pain when turning my head.
I've been told it's a neck strain.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment?
A: I went to an urgent care clinic the same day and then saw my regular doctor a few days later. I'm doing physical
therapy twice a week now.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Some, yes. Driving for long stretches bothers me, and I've had some headaches. It's improving, but slowly.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: Only that I've been cooperative and I'm happy to send any medical records you need.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,

  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
